predecessors.name: Kaabu
predecessors.text: Fuladu, 'in the upper Casamance region of southern Senegal, extending to parts of The Gambia', as the Kolda region and the Gambian Upper River and Central River (the page also reaches 'northeastern…

successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: the French sphere of Fuladu round Kolda and Ndorna, which Musa Molo held until May 1903

ledger.x: May 1867: Fuladu takes the upper Casamance and Gambia lands from Kaabu.
May 1903: Musa Molo leaves the French sphere.
1903: the last independent pre-colonial state in the area ends.

wars.name: Battle of Kansala
wars.outcome: The Fulbe took Kansala, capital of Kaabu, in an 11-day fight; the kaabu dossier dates it 13-24 May 1867 (Battle of Kansala page).

wars.name: Musa Molo against Fode Kaba
wars.outcome: "In 1901 his forces defeated and killed Fode Kaba."

certainty.note: The page gives the upper Casamance and parts of the Gambia and Guinea-Bissau, with no outline.
The Senegalese part is drawn as the Kolda region; the French and British spheres of 1900 are not outlined on the page.
